body.p: After , . Owns new grammars/value_template/, grammars/CMakeLists.txt, tools/qt4-parse-check.py, src/xslt_value_template.c, tests/xslt_value_template_test.c. Attribute and text value templates: a tree-sitter grammar inheriting grammars/xpath (, ) for fixed parts, {{ }} escapes and enclosed expressions; lowered as string templates are. XTSE0350, XTSE0370. Done when every AVT and TVT of the in-scope stylesheets parses (a value-template mode of tools/qt4-parse-check.py --spec XT40). Spec: XSLT 4.0 "Value Templates". Done 2026-10-17 (): sxml_xslt_build_value_template_ast in src/xslt_value_template_internal.h; --value-templates accepts all 12,232 valid value templates of the in-scope stylesheets.
